title: Open Day on 25 October
summary: Meet the faculties and institutes, see the laboratories and training centres, and ask the admissions office your questions.

body.text: On 25 October the university will hold an Open Day in the main building. The event starts at 10:00. Guests will enjoy programme presentations, laboratory tours and a meeting with the university leadership.
Pre-registration is required. The link will appear on the home page and in the Admissions section.
